column1: # Rows of exactly five tab-separated fields: kind, path, category, count, reason.
#   use     a build file's shell sites per category (busybox_sh, sh_argv, shell_path,
#           sh_script, shell_rule): the count must equal the file's. A new site fails
#           the build; a removed one fails until the row is lowered or removed.
#   script  a shell script an action or test still runs: to be ported, then the row goes.
#   human   a shell script (or a directory of them, ending in /) that only people and CI
#           runners run, never a build or test action. The only places a new script may live.
# A row is added only with a reason review accepts.
